title: Linear velocity magnitude
description: Essential: The student's final answer for linear speed must be 10 m/s, correctly calculated from distance and time.

title: Angular velocity magnitude
description: Essential: The student's final answer for angular speed must be 0.5 rad/s, correctly derived from linear velocity and radius.

title: Centripetal acceleration magnitude
description: Essential: The student's final answer for centripetal acceleration must be 5 m/s², using either a = v²/r or a = rω².

title: Correct formula application
description: Important: The solution must correctly apply the definitions v = s/t, ω = v/r, and a = v²/r or a = rω².

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: All final answers should be presented with correct SI units (m/s, rad/s, m/s²).

title: Confusing linear and angular
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student incorrectly calculates angular velocity as θ/t without first finding the angle or misuses the radius.

title: Algebraic or arithmetic error
description: Pitfall: Penalize significant calculation mistakes in the intermediate or final steps, such as miscomputing v or ω.
